previous_statement: Functional calculus commutes with this amplification: applying lem-compcb-amplification-naturality to T_{P,Q} gives theta(I_n tensor T_{P,Q})=I_n tensor theta(T_{P,Q}) whenever the stated convergence condition holds; using def-compressed-corner, theta(T_{P,Q})=Co_{P,Q} and theta(T_{P_n,Q_n})=Co_{P_n,Q_n}.
new_statement: Functional calculus commutes with this amplification: apply lem-compcb-amplification-naturality in the unital Banach algebra of bounded operators under composition, with its argument P there instantiated as A_{P,Q}=(L_P R_Q+R_Q L_P)/2. Its particular theta clause gives theta(I_n tensor(2A_{P,Q}-I))=I_n tensor theta(2A_{P,Q}-I) when ||(2A_{P,Q}-I)^2-I||<1. Together with T_{P_n,Q_n}=I_n tensor T_{P,Q} and def-compressed-corner, this is Co_{P_n,Q_n}=I_n tensor Co_{P,Q}.
